title: Line icon morph chain into a loader
summary: One centred line icon on a flat warm colour turns into the next every 1-2 s: bag, plane, window, globe, pin, then it collapses to a dash that fans into a spinning loader and vanishes. One stroke weight ties the chain into a single journey.
use_when: Linking 4-6 feature or journey steps with one icon each, no copy needed
A short looping explainer for an icon set or a step-by-step flow
A transition sting between scenes of a longer film
Ending on a loading or processing state before a result

look.type_style: no type; rounded line icons, black stroke about 1.5 % of frame height, round caps, icon about 22-30 % of frame height, centred

sfx.event: each icon morph settles into the next symbol
dash fans out into the radial loader

structure.shot: empty flat yellow, then a black line bag icon grows in at centre and holds
structure.motion: 0.00 empty; bag appears flat and short at 0.27, body and handle grow up to full height by 0.50 with springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); hold f15-f45

structure.shot: the bag tilts and becomes a plane icon pointing up-right, held centred
structure.motion: morph measured on a 30 fps strip: f46 bag rotated ~10 deg, f47 plane complete (2 fr swap, easings.outExpo); plane holds f47-f68; leaves between 2.27 and 2.50 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the plane becomes a tilted rounded-square window; it rights itself and two cloud strokes trace in inside its frame
structure.motion: window enters tilted ~15 deg and rotates upright by 3.00 with springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s); cloud strokes draw on 2.77-3.77, easings.outQuint; window narrows 2.50->3.00

structure.shot: the window rounds into a globe; the cloud lines slide round it as continents, then merge into one wave line inside the ring
structure.motion: square->circle 4.00-4.27 (±0.25 s); inner lines rotate around the ring 4.27-5.50, easings.inOutSine; reduce to one S-line by 5.77; ring stroke thickens at 6.00 just before the next morph

structure.shot: the globe ring becomes a map pin with an inner circle; the inner line closes into the circle
structure.motion: ring sharpens to a pin point 6.27-6.50, inner line closes to a ring by 6.77, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); hold to f225; strip: pin swells ~+13 % f225-f229, easings.inExpo

structure.shot: the pin collapses to a small oval that thins into a single short vertical dash above centre, held
structure.motion: strip: f230 pin gone, small oval left; oval narrows to a filled dash f230-f240, easings.outExpo; dash holds f240-f263

structure.shot: the dash tilts and fans out clockwise into a ring of twelve radial ticks around the centre
structure.motion: dash tilts at 8.77; 3 ticks at 9.00, half ring at 9.27, full ring of 12 at 9.50: ticks unfold one after another, stagger ~1 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint

structure.shot: the twelve-tick loader spins in place, then shrinks to nothing
structure.motion: rotation easings.linear (rate not measurable: 12-fold symmetry aliases at 4 fps); strip: shrink f341-f344 ~-10 %, gone at f345, easings.inExpo 4 fr

structure.shot: empty flat yellow hold that matches frame 0, so the chain loops

params.brand: any brand.json: bg fills the frame, fg is the icon stroke
params.content.icons: 4-6 line icons as SVG path data (or LineGlyph names), one per step, in journey order
params.content.endWithLoader: true = last icon collapses to a dash and fans into the radial loader (default true)
params.timing.hold: frames each icon holds between morphs (reference 21-45 fr at 30 fps)
params.timing.tailHold: empty frames at the end for a clean loop (reference 38)
params.stroke: stroke width as a share of frame height (reference ~1.5 %)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; icon stays centred, size from the short side
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts, no camera: every change is the icon itself. Morphs are fast (2 fr bag->plane measured on a 30 fps strip) and the holds carry the rhythm: 46, 29, 53, 60, 42, 33, 22, 60, 38 fr. All icons share one stroke weight and round caps; that is what reads as one continuous line. Pin swells ~13 % before collapsing (anticipation). Proposed terms not in the vocabulary: icon-morph-chain, stroke-draw, radial-fan. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
